name: cavemio-tabs
title: Tabs
description: Views of one thing: the underline or pill is thrown to the new tab, the panel slides in from the side you moved toward, and counts roll.

cavemio.accessibility:
- tablist, tab and tabpanel roles, aria-selected and aria-controls.
- Reduced motion: the indicator and panel change in place.
- Use the segmented control when there are no panels.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

features.title: Thrown indicator
features.description: Measured from layout; overshoot on position, eased width.

features.title: Directional panels
features.description: Enter from the side you moved toward, leave the other way, height eased.

features.title: Scrolls on phones
features.description: The strip scrolls the chosen tab into view, never the page.

states.title: pick
states.description: Indicator thrown (440ms, slight overshoot), width eased (400ms).

states.title: panel
states.description: New panel slides 20px out of a 4px blur (380ms); old one leaves the other way (200ms); height eases (380ms).

states.title: keys
states.description: Arrows move and select; Home and End jump.
